A project to provide direct assistance to farmers' accounts by sugar cooperatives against sale of bio-compost by sugar cooperatives.
₹100/- per metric ton against the total metric ton sales of bio compost volume. or a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- whichever is less

schemeContent.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to support sugar co-operatives by providing financial assistance for modernization, diversification, organic fertilizer production to enhance sugarcane farming and the sugar industry.

children.text: The scheme "Package for strengthening to sugar co-operatives as may be policy decided by the State Government" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial aid to sugar co-operative societies for projects such as modernization, upgradation, tissue culture labs, molasses-based distilleries, storage system improvements, and cost reduction initiatives. It also offers direct assistance to farmers for the sale of bio-compost, phospho-compost, and vermicompost.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme &quot;Package for strengthening to sugar co-operatives as may be policy decided by the State Government&quot; introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial aid to sugar co-operative societies for projects such as modernization, upgradation, tissue culture labs, molasses-based distilleries, storage system improvements, and cost reduction initiatives. It also offers direct assistance to farmers for the sale of bio-compost, phospho-compost, and vermicompost.

en.documentsRequired_md:
1. Project-related details
1. Name of the project for financial assistance
1. Unit under the project to increase sugarcane production and productivity (show separate quantities for each unit and single IB)
1. Expected number of beneficiaries (Bio Vermi, Horho, Tyru, and Single IB)
1. Is the land owned? Copy of 7/12 land record extract
1. Is it obtained or on lease?
1. Sale price per unit shown under the agricultural project
1. Technical opinion from Agricultural University and an authenticated certificate – certified copy
1. For infrastructure-based technical projects, has the government-approved engineer’s report been prepared with planning, design, and technical authentication? If yes, a certified copy of the approved engineer’s license is required.
1. Expected benefits of the project (Increase in production, productivity, expansion, technical reasons, potential employment growth, possible increase in state revenue).
1. Any other documents if required.
